title: Crown OS desktop
summary: Use the upstairs garage computer for a personal mini desktop with jobs, notes, files and a calculator.
notes: Add a classic desktop with icon shortcuts, a Start menu, bottom taskbar and draggable, resizable application windows that can stay visible together.
Keep garage jobs and rewards in their existing server-owned system.
Add a top New/Save notes toolbar with unsaved-change confirmation, private session documents, a compact calculator and an in-computer help guide.
